title: Approvals
description: Per-user approval state for machine-health remediations and check overrides. Lives at $OutputBase/state/approvals.json. Not checked into source control. Written only by /machine-health:setup (Set-ApprovalState) and by the one-time migration on first run; do not edit it by hand.

remediations.description: Keyed by remediation id as declared in reference/<os>/remediation-policy.md.

approved.description: True enables the remediation on non-dry-run runs.

approved_by.description: Free-form identifier for audit (hostname, username, or note).

check_overrides.description: Per-check user-curated state, keyed by check id. Optional.

noise_allowlist.description: Ignored: no check reads it. Still accepted so an existing approvals.json that holds it validates.

service_exclusions.description: Service names Restart-StoppedService never starts (exact name, case-insensitive; per-host).

migration.description: Populated on first migration from TODO.md. Removed in next major version.
